description.name: Quad Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Dark] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning/Dark ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Y'shtola
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Spiritual Ray (0~2), removed after using Spiritual Ray two times

description.name: Spiritual Ray Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Spiritual Ray level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Y'shtola]

description.name: Spiritual Ray Level
description.text: Keeps track of Spiritual Ray level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Y'shtola]
